title: Rashtrakutas
definition: A powerful imperial dynasty that ruled the Deccan and parts of Central India from the 8th to the 10th century, acting as a bridge between North and South Indian politics.
importanceInUpsc: Frequent source of questions regarding the Tripartite Struggle, temple architecture (Ellora/Elephanta), and administrative decentralization in the Early Medieval period.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rashtrakutas.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
